articles.title: North Korean hackers are moving tens of millions on Hyperliquid as Trump pushes to onshore the crypto platform
articles.snippet: Blockchain data reviewed by CoinDesk shows wallets tied to North Korea’s Lazarus Group sold more than $30 million in bitcoin on the platform in the last three weeks alone.

articles.title: Kalshi lays down first lifetime ban for ex-member of Congress George Santos
articles.snippet: The prediction market platform banned Santos for manipulation as part of the industry's ongoing efforts to show it's dealing with bad behavior.

articles.title: NYSE owner ICE taps tZERO for tokenized securities push, takes stake in firm
articles.snippet: The deal adds transfer-agent and settlement infrastructure to ICE's plans for an NYSE-affiliated market for tokenized stocks, tZERO said.

articles.title: Ireland bars crypto from new tax-advantaged investment accounts
articles.snippet: Eligible assets for the new accounts include listed stocks, bonds, and ETFs, with providers handling tax reporting to simplify investor compliance.

articles.title: Bitmine makes largest ether purchase since June as Tom Lee points to crypto's strong Q3
articles.snippet: Company Chairman Lee said crypto’s recent outperformance could draw more institutional investors.
